title: Signboards and the sand strip load lighter
items: Nothing you can see changed. The grain and relief under every hanging signboard are now prepared once, ahead of time, instead of in your browser at every visit: the boards look the same and the walk downloads about 360 KB less to stand in the street.
The dune sand on the ground-strip proof view now loads as a GPU-compressed texture, as the muck beside it already did.
